title: Orders to chase
prompt: Customer service follows up on orders that are still `placed` or `paid` (so not shipped yet) and were ordered before 1 April 2026. Write `solve(orders)` so it returns `order_id`, `customer_id` and `status` for those orders.
rules: `order_date` is before 2026-04-01. An order from 1 April itself doesn't count.
Return only `order_id`, `customer_id` and `status`, in that order.
hints: `F.col("status").isin("placed", "paid")` covers both statuses in one condition.
Filter first, then `select` the three columns.
starter:
from pyspark.sql import functions as F


def solve(orders):
    # Return order_id, customer_id and status of the orders to chase.
    return orders
